experimentalOverlay.overallTrajectoryDiagnosis: ACTIVE DISSOLUTION DETECTED: 2 test point(s) (Test Point #1, Test Point #2) are located in the active acid corrosion domain with rapid uniform metal loss driven by cathodic depolarization.

engineeringMitigations: Apply Cathodic Protection (CP) to depress potential below immunity boundary (E < -1.75 V vs SHE).
Add anodic passivation inhibitors (e.g. chromates, nitrites, molybdates) or neutralizers to shift pH > 7.0.
points.mechanismDetails: Al → Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ active dissolution. Rapid hydrogen gas evolution (H⁺ (HER)).
points.name: Test Point #1

engineeringMitigations: Buffer pH down to neutral regime (pH 6 - 9) to prevent amphoteric/caustic dissolution.
Inspect for Caustic Stress Corrosion Cracking (SCC) in weld heat-affected zones.
points.mechanismDetails: Hydroxide ions dissolve the alumina passive film: Al + 4OH⁻ → Al(OH)₄⁻ + 3e⁻.
points.name: Test Point #2
